page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Benchmark results show strong single-core and multi-core performance. The instance achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 2018.0 and a multi-core score of 17012.0, both placing in the top 25% of tested servers. Cryptographic capabilities are also strong, with a Passmark CPU encryption test score of 39057.13, aided by hardware-accelerated AES and SHA instructions. However, multi-core CPU performance under stress-ng (49876.81) and memory bandwidth read-only large block operations (96.44 GB/sec) fall into the average tier.

The absence of local NVMe storage requires reliance on network storage, which may impact I/O-intensive workloads. However, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8 makes this instance suitable for memory-bound applications. Appropriate workloads include database operations, in-memory caching, text and image processing, and enterprise applications that require dedicated CPU allocation without GPU acceleration.
